meta.name: porch
meta.description: Protocol orchestrator CLI — drives SPIR, ASPIR, AIR, and BUGFIX protocols via a state machine. ALWAYS check this skill before running any `porch` command. Use when you need to check project status, approve gates, signal phase completion, or manage protocol state. Also use when a builder asks about gate approvals or phase transitions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过状态机驱动协议流程，管理项目状态与门禁审批
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发流程中管理协议状态和门禁审批
copy.tagline_en: Drive protocol workflows via state machine, manage project status and gate approvals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage protocol state and gate approvals in development workflows

howto.what: 当你需要管理开发协议（如SPIR、ASPIR等）的进度时，Claude会使用porch命令来检查状态、批准门控、标记阶段完成等。它不会自动批准门控，但可以执行你指令的操作。
howto.when: 当你运行任何porch命令时，或者构建者问及门控批准、阶段转换时，Claude会引用该技能来确保正确操作。

say.note: 执行 porch status，显示阶段和门控状态。
执行 porch done，推进到下一阶段。

howto.what_en: Porch skill enables Claude to manage protocol state using commands: check status, approve gates, signal phase completion, etc. It never auto-approves gates.
howto.when_en: Whenever you need to run a porch command, or a builder asks about gate approvals or phase transitions, Claude will consult this skill.

say_en.note: Runs porch status to show phase and gate state.
Runs porch done to advance to next phase.
